title: Plantar Analgesia Test for Hind Paw and Tail
author: Eva Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8a3hsgn
materials: - Must clean equipment with sporeklenz before entering the animal room - All restrainers need to be exclusively used in same room. If restrainer has been in another animal room, it CANNOT be used! - The True Tail Temp cannot be used for the paw test. It must be disabled. Press 6000E on keypad of CPU. It is on by default. - Test Head needs to be removed from Tail Flick machine and placed under heated glass. - Never remove cable from test head or back of tail flick machine when it is on. Failure to pay attention may damage electrical circuits in machine.

steps.title: Configure Machine Settings
steps.instruction: Use the keyboard commands to set the machine parameters.

substeps.instruction: Set Animal Number (#2): e.g., 2011E for animal 11
Set Cutoff Timer (#5): 35 seconds (e.g., 5025E for 25 seconds)
Set Time of Day (#7): 24 hr format, 5 digit sequence (e.g., 00100E for 1am)

steps.title: Acclimate Mice to Machine
steps.instruction: Acclimate each animal to the machine using three 15-minute sessions.

substeps.instruction: Turn on heat to medium (roughly 32ºC) 10 minutes before animals enter the box.

steps.title: Prepare Animals for Testing
steps.instruction: Initialize the machine for the first animal and position the subjects.

substeps.instruction: For the first animal, type 6000E, 4001E, 3015E, 5015E, and set the time and date.
Place 1 mouse in each of the 6 cubes and allow them to settle for 15 minutes.
Once the mouse is calm, position the Test Head under the paw.
Use the minimum amount of idle intensity necessary to focus the beam properly to avoid negative conditioning.

steps.title: Perform Analgesia Test
steps.instruction: Execute the heat test and record the response time.

substeps.instruction: Start the test by pressing the footswitch or the red button.
Stop the test by pressing the red button or footswitch immediately when the mouse moves its paw.
Observe the three flashing numbers: P (Finish temp), B (Start temp), and Blank (elapsed time).

steps.title: Collect Data
steps.instruction: Retrieve the test results from the machine.

substeps.instruction: Collect data manually after each test (recommended) or use a printer to print a full page of data.
